name: arduforge
description: Local-first visual programming environment for Arduino. Node graph in, readable Arduino C++ out.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.import:browser: playwright install chromium && npm run build --workspace client && tsx --tsconfig client/tsconfig.json scripts/verify-browser.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run contrast && npm test && npm run import:grammar && npm run import:selftest && npm run import:frontend && npm run import:idempotence && npm run import:golden && npm run import:browser && npm run import:corpus
